task.title: Deduplicate final observation persistence
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/587 by centralizing final observation validation and parent-aware persistence without changing provider-tool runtime behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Extract one private helper for final TaskObservationText validation and parent-aware append dispatch.
Reuse the helper from initial and continuation observation bridges.
Preserve Attempt and Correction error mapping, parent linkage, task storage error sources, ordered commits, and public APIs.
Introduce no new behavior or dependency.

attempts.summary: Used merged characterization coverage as the refactor safety net.
attempts.diagnostic: The substantive review of pull request 586 found byte-equivalent final-observation validation and append dispatch in initial and continuation bridges.
attempts.patch: Confirmed the full tool-task runtime integration suite covered root Attempts, parent-linked Corrections, error mapping, and persistence before editing.

attempts.diagnostic: One private helper can validate provider text, map errors by observation kind, and choose root or parent-linked task storage append semantics.
attempts.patch: Added persist_final_observation and replaced both duplicated blocks while preserving call order and error conversion.

attempts.summary: Verified behavior neutrality and recovered remote gates.
attempts.diagnostic: The first GitHub Actions attempts failed before creating a job and CodeRabbit was rate limited; no code-level failure existed. The same exact head later received successful Rust quality and substantive no-finding review results.
attempts.patch: Kept the exact head unchanged, reran the remote quality gate after runner recovery, resumed review once after cooldown, and left auto-merge disabled until both gates completed.

attempts.diagnostic: All 30 tool-task runtime tests, pinned verification, independent review, Rust quality gate run 30158206803, and CodeRabbit review passed with no actionable findings.
attempts.patch: Pull request 588 squash-merged as a38656a560ca7dde7f5086bb4ce28c3ea1e1fa85 and closed issue 587.

outcome.summary: Initial and continuation provider-tool bridges now share one final-observation validation and persistence helper while retaining existing Attempt, Correction, lineage, and error behavior.

verification.command: nix develop --command cargo test -p vela-kernel --test tool_task_runtime --locked # 30 passed
Independent pre-commit review # no correctness findings
GitHub Rust quality gate https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/actions/runs/30158206803 and substantive CodeRabbit review at https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/pull/588

lessons: Behavior-neutral refactors can use established characterization coverage instead of inventing artificial failing behavior tests.
Observation-kind error mapping and parent-aware append dispatch form one cohesive private persistence responsibility.
Remote runner failures before job creation are infrastructure diagnostics, not evidence for speculative code changes.
Preserving an exact verified head allows remote gates to recover without review churn.
